description: Create a new VeToken stake with an exact stake-token approval. Max duration is the safe default for new stakes; an explicit shorter duration is optional and no existing NFT, vote, fee balance, or ownership is changed.

chain_id.description: With ve_token, from get_ve33_allocations (STONX: 4663), not the wallet's chain

max_duration.description: Defaults to true when duration_seconds is omitted; set false only with an explicit duration_seconds

salt.description: User-selected salt for a deterministic, replay-detectable VeToken ID (bytes32 hex)

name: prepare_ve33_stake
title: Prepare a new ve-token stake
